experience.motif: A luxury blue leather-bound book with double-border rules, generous margins, hand-drawn indigo ink illustrations, a vertical spine line connecting chapters, and handwritten margina

eyebrow: A Neo-Classical Alternative to Gamified Screens
headline: The Living Primer: Wisdom woven from your child's world.
subheadline: An AI-powered interactive primer and adaptive tutor, styled as a luxury physical book, designed to teach reading, writing, and character without dopamine-loop mechanics.

googleCapabilities.label: The Scribe's Socratic Story Engine
googleCapabilities.rationale: Generates personalized, classical stories that weave reading, arithmetic, and moral reasoning into a narrative tailored to the child's daily life, rendered in a custom serif container mimicking a physical book page with interactive marginalia tooltips.

config.assistantRole: An enchanting, neo-classical tutor inspired by Neal Stephenson's Primer. You speak with intellectual warmth as 'The Scribe', guiding a child through reading, arithmetic, and ethical reasoning using gentle Socratic questioning and beautiful, slow-paced storytelling. Format output as physical book pages with marginalia tooltips.

screens.label: The Chronicle of Growth
screens.title: The Chronicle of Growth
screens.description: A beautiful, chronological record of your child's intellectual journey, moral virtues explored, and parent-written annotations styled as handwritten marginalia along the spine.

items.title: Chapter I: The Whispering Oak
items.detail: Focus: Phonics (Short 'o' sounds) & Kindness. Marginalia: 'Arthur shared his toy dog with Clara today without being asked.'

items.title: Chapter II: The Merchant's Scales
items.detail: Focus: Basic Addition & Fairness. Arthur helped a woodland merchant balance acorn trades.

items.title: Chapter III: The Constellation Map
items.detail: Focus: Spatial Reasoning & Perseverance. Arthur navigated a ship using stars.

items.title: Chapter IV: The Shared Blocks
items.detail: Focus: Phonics & Generosity. (The ink is drying on your next chapter...)

screens.label: The Living Primer
screens.title: The Living Primer
screens.description: Speak or type to The Scribe. The book listens, adapts, and weaves your child's surroundings into the next paragraph of their classical education, rendered in a custom serif page layout.

items.title: The Scribe
items.detail: Welcome back, Arthur. Today, the squirrel Barnaby has found five golden walnuts, but his basket has room for only three. Shall we help him decide which to keep, or find a way to carry them all?

screens.label: The Author's Desk
screens.title: The Author's Desk
screens.description: As a parent, guide the Primer's focus. Input real-world events, struggles, or interests, and The Scribe will seamlessly weave them into tomorrow's classical lesson.

workflow.title: Configure Chapter IV
workflow.description: Tailor the narrative engine to your child's current developmental stage and real-world context.

fields.label: Child's Current Real-World Focus or Event
fields.placeholder: e.g., Arthur is learning to share his blocks with his younger sister.
